answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 164517 Country: INDIA Title: Is Salah Valid with a Small Hole in Clothing Below the Knee? Question: Can a person offer salah when a hole of 0.5 cm diameter is on the shalwar just below the knee portion of the shalwar. And was my salah accepted when I have offered salah wearing it. Answer ID: 164517 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1525/1321/L=01/1440) The satr of male is from navel below the knees. Thus if the hole is below the knee then salah is valid without any karahat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
